author: Jincheng Liu
amendment_rationale: A post-outcome development diagnostic did not support direct future-condition coefficient shifts. V4.1 isolates the less assumptive explicit-elapsed dual-clock component. The diagnostic is not independent validation and no Hithium outcome was accessed.
decision_rule: V4.1 may replace V3 only when a deployment-candidate schedule passes every frozen gate on the batch-disjoint Hithium calibration partition. Otherwise V3 remains primary. The full V4 condition-delta model remains a negative control and cannot be revived by retuning on that calibration result.
claim_boundary: This amendment was frozen without Hithium measurements, but after an outcome-exposed public-data diagnostic; therefore V4.1 requires separately controlled Hithium calibration and one locked-test execution. Oracle schedules cannot support deployment claims. No result alone establishes 15-25 year accuracy.
